title: CLAWSTRIKE
author: Rémi Vansteelandt
desc_full: Avenge your fallen human and cut through waves of enemies across fast-paced, punishingly fun levels. CLAWSTRIKE is a die-and-retry action game: you’ll fall often, but each retry is instant, keeping the momentum alive. Prove your skill and unlock 9 Lives Mode by completing the game. Controls Move: ↑ ← ↓ → or W A S D Attack: Space Roll: ↓ Meow: E Optimized for both mobile and desktop so you can avenge your human anywhere.
